description:
Although steep in places, this is a well constructed trail in its lower reaches. For the first 3.5 km from the end of McBride Street the path gains about 200 meters in elevation, then rises steeply beyond this point. It travels through an attractive section of thick, mature hemlock forest.

For experienced and properly equipped hikers only, this is also the route leading to Hagwilget Peak.
directions: A gravel road extends from the south end of McBride Street in New Hazelton. This road is gated at 800m.
title: Station Creek Trail
